reason: A DeepSeek Harness web UI enhancement centered on customizable themes, animated desktop pets, ambient audio, gamified focus and break features, and interactive fun commands.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可自定义主题、动画桌宠、环境音效以及专注和休息互动功能的网页界面增强插件。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness web interface enhancement offering customizable themes, animated desktop pets, ambient audio, and interactive focus and break features.

capabilities: Provides interactive web UI enhancements and customizable themes
Displays customizable animated desktop-pet imagery and optional Live2D models
Stores plugin settings, interaction statistics, achievements, and affinity data in browser-local storage
Uses browser speech synthesis or a user-specified local TTS API
Can open user-configured URLs or launch user-configured local program paths
Can load selected external assets and models from community or CDN sources
